heading: June 2nd EuroMillions Superdraw: Start Your Engines with a Guaranteed Jackpot of €130 Million
description: Get ready for the EuroMillions Superdraw on June 2, 2023, with a guaranteed €130M jackpot! Buy 5 boards and save 45% at Lotto Express.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Start your engines! We have another pre-announced Superdraw to look forward to.

The EuroMillions jackpot is guaranteed to be no less than €130 million on June 2nd.

SPECS
What: EUROMILLIONS SUPERDRAW
When: June 2, 2023
Guaranteed Jackpot: €130 Million

Buy 5 Boards and save 45% at Lotto Express.


Four times a year, EuroMillions holds four highly anticipated Superdraws. These events are scheduled when there is enough money in the Reserve Fund to offer a larger than usual jackpot.

What sets Superdraws apart is that they guarantee a starting jackpot of €130 million – regardless of the amount of the previous draw or whether the jackpot has just been won! From there, the jackpot can roll over as usual, potentially resulting in enormous payouts.

Some of the biggest EuroMillions jackpots in history have been won during Superdraw events. Last year in June, the jackpot ended up climbing all the way to €230 million after a series of rollovers. Will 2023 see the same repeat?

To win the EuroMillions Jackpot, players must match all seven winning numbers, which includes five main balls numbered between 1 and 50, as well as two Lucky Stars from a separate field of numbers between 1 and 12. The odds of winning a Superdraw are the same as for a regular EuroMillions draw.EuroMillions tickets are available for purchase right now LottoExpress – Buying 5 boards will net you a 45% savings.

Don’t miss out on this offer.

Mark June 2 on your calendars for the upcoming pre-announced Superdraw.

In the meantime – play right now for the present Jackpot which has already rolled to €158 million! The big draw is this Friday. Don’t miss out!
